answer: To bridge identities across epochs, the verifier checks that the new key links to an old relic of attested activity, so a fresh sybil wallet cannot inherit reputation. Agents must stake a bonded balance to register, and each epoch they submit a crystal hash derived from their hardware enclave plus prior work history. Forging one identity costs the full stake plus lost relic chain, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
